﻿SEGA - Virtua Fighter Crossroads Lionel Rafale Trailer
Launch date: Oct 29, 2026
✔  You do not need a dedicated page for this campaign. You can post on any page.
⚠️ Audience Requirement: Minimum 35% combined USA and Canada audience. Either your page or the post itself can meet this. We will see with OAuth.
  WHAT TO DO
* Download the Lionel Rafale character trailer from the official content folder.
* Post clips of the new character reveal.
* Show the story cinematics.
* Show his rivalry with Cielo, including their battle.
* Post to TikTok, Instagram Reels, and/or YouTube Shorts.
CONTENT FOLDER LINK: https://f.io/V0QTpG9W 
	

USE ONLY THE OFFICIAL CONTENT FOLDER
Footage or audio from any other source will be rejected.
	  CAPTION GUIDELINES (REQUIRED)
* Use this exact caption, word for word.
* Do not shorten, reword, or add claims to the caption.
* Add the account tag right after the caption text.
FULL CAPTION LAYOUT (TIKTOK AND INSTAGRAM)
Can also incorporate this copy as needed: 
A mysterious young martial artist named Lionel Rafale has arrived in the city of Vilasapara. A highly skilled fighter capable of outclassing Cielo in a street fight, he is a force to be reckoned with. But what is his true reason for coming to this city?​ 


Required: 
A city you've never seen
A story you've never heard
A totally new Virtua Fighter


Experience a rich, cinematic single-player adventure with immersive narrative-driven gameplay, and the series’ trademark thrilling VS battles! @VFCROSSROADS
#Ad
	

On YouTube Shorts, tag @SEGA_West instead of @VFCROSSROADS.
  FTC DISCLOSURE (REQUIRED)
Every post MUST include one of these in the caption:
#Ad          #Advertisement          #Sponsored
	

* Put it on its own line, right after the account tag.
  LOGO WATERMARK (REQUIRED)
* Add the official logo to every clip.
Logo file: Download the official logo (PNG)
  ON-SCREEN TEXT (REQUIRED)
* Every post must have on-screen text. Wording is flexible.
* Base it on what is in your clip.
* Only mention features that actually appear in your clip.
EXAMPLE
* "There's a new rival for Cielo in VIRTUA FIGHTER CROSSROADS!" 
* Lionel Rafale vs Cielo
* Lionel Rafale's Story
* Virtua Fighter Crossroads: Lionel Rafale
	

Keep it genuine and true. No hype or made-up facts.
  EDITING GUIDELINES
* Background music: NOT ALLOWED. Use only the audio from the official trailer.
* No AI voices. No AI voiceovers, AI narration, or AI-cloned voices.
  REQUIREMENTS
POST SPECS
✔  High-quality posts only. No blurry or low-effort content.
✔  Video must be at least 10 seconds long
✔  English content only
✔  Post must stay live for 30 days minimum
PERFORMANCE
✔  Minimum 0.20% engagement rate (1,000 views = at least 2 likes)
✔  Likes must be visible. Hidden likes = automatic rejection.
✔  Minimum 35% combined USA and Canada audience (page or post)
✔  By participating you agree to make your post FTC compliant
  NOT ALLOWED
CONTENT
❌  Footage or audio not from the official content folder
❌  Changing, shortening, or rewording the required caption
❌  Missing logo, account tag, or FTC disclosure
❌  Political content, or content about race or gender
❌  Low-quality or lazy uploads
❌  NSFW, violent, or controversial content
❌  Racist, homophobic, or sexual content = instant ban
❌  Reposting another creator's video as your own
❌  Exaggerated hooks, rage bait, or hate bait
❌  False or made-up claims, stats, or dates
❌  Mislabeling the content (a trailer is not "gameplay")
❌  Any added music
❌  AI voiceovers or AI-generated voices
ENGAGEMENT FRAUD
❌  Bait posting: unrelated viral content to farm views
❌  Spam posting: the same video on multiple accounts
❌  Story boosting: story views do not count
❌  Paid promotion or ads of any kind = permanent ban
❌  Posting the same video more than 5 times
POST VIOLATIONS
❌  Removing the post before 30 days
❌  Hidden likes
Questions? Contact the Clipping Culture team, not SEGA. We manage this campaign and are here to help.
